goal: Does localization improvement increase Coding Agent end-to-end SWE-bench resolve rate?

coding_agent.implementation_status: design_only: coding tools and cloud runner are not yet implemented or validated; all arms must share one frozen implementation before any holdout run
coding_agent.sandbox: linux/amd64 x86_64 Docker; fresh base commit per arm and repeat; network disabled; no evaluator secrets or reference/test patches; git diff exported by harness
coding_agent.version_gate: verify actual backend immediately before experiment; record response model/system_fingerprint when available; stop on observed drift; absent immutable provider revision is a disclosed limitation; no replacement model without a new preregistration before outcomes

locator.repeat_policy: independent locator run per task/repeat in B and C; never select best run

B.name: current_localization
B.retrieval: v6 identifier BM25 + v7 finish selfcheck; source previews and exact/path route; no dense
B.implementation: historical workspace/experiments/sdk_finish_selfcheck_v7 and retrieval_evidence_v6 as pinned in stage1-lock

C.name: improved_localization
C.retrieval: v8.1 full function-body BM25 + true dense cosine; per-entity max chunk; weighted RRF 60/1/2; span-bound duplicate definitions
C.dense_status: not_ready: present runtime deliberately accepts synthetic offline fixtures only; real-cache adapter must be completed and frozen using dev37 before any holdout run

future_embedding_binding.reason: input manifest freezes exact texts independently; provider/model revision/dimensions/instruction/token cap require separate binding before real encoding; no synthetic vectors in effectiveness experiment

input_envelope: Same coding system prompt + issue statement + nullable localization_packet; no arm label, gold labels, old answers, or reference patch. No localization retrieval tool available during coding. Coding tools/budgets are identical. Packet tokens count toward coding input budget; A receives no token compensation.

schedule.request_failure: stop experiment, preserve partial evidence, no automatic retry or replacement; independently scheduled repeats are not retries

evaluation.dataset_policy: offline pinned dataset revision only, validate SHA before passing local dataset or validated HF cache; never silently use moving main
evaluation.image_status: not_built; freeze image digests, x86 host environment and coding runner hash before first holdout execution
evaluation.primary: official resolved: reference FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS checks satisfied
evaluation.denominator: all 50 instances times all 3 planned repeats per arm; failures, empty patches, timeouts and missing outputs count as zero in intention-to-treat; also report technical failures separately
evaluation.result_visibility: sealed until all dev37 tuning and final code lock complete; no early peeking; any holdout result exposure retires this cohort from future tuning claims

statistics.unit: instance; average its three binary resolved outcomes
statistics.paired_test: two-sided paired cluster sign-flip permutation; 100000 Monte Carlo samples; seed 20261116; plus-one correction
statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across all three contrasts at alpha 0.05
statistics.confidence_interval: 95% paired bootstrap by instance, stratified by repository, 20000 draws; no treating 450 trials as independent
statistics.sensitivity: exact two-sided McNemar on first predesignated repeat only; report discordant counts; never best-of-three/pass@3 as primary
